aboutGame.title: What is Army Escape?
paragraphs: Army Escape is an exciting military battle simulator on Roblox created by 50/50 Games. Build your personal squad, defeat aggressive enemy mobs, and push through challenging escape stages to earn coveted wins.
As you progress, level up your commander to equip more troops simultaneously, unbox powerful rare soldiers, and master tactical squad synergies to conquer every zone on Roblox.

items.question: What is Army Escape on Roblox?
items.answer: Army Escape is a Roblox squad battle simulator developed by 50/50 Games. Players assemble soldiers, defeat enemy mobs, conquer escape stages, and earn wins to unbox more powerful troops.

items.question: How do I equip more soldiers in Army Escape?
items.answer: In Army Escape, leveling up your commander and progressing through stages unlocks additional soldier equip capacity, allowing you to field larger squads.

items.question: Where do I find active Army Escape codes?
items.answer: All working Army Escape codes and redemption methods are tracked on our Codes guide. Redeem codes in the game menu whenever new developer milestones are reached.

items.question: What is the fastest way to get wins in Army Escape?
items.answer: The fastest way to farm wins in Army Escape is by repeatedly clearing the highest stage your squad can defeat quickly without taking heavy soldier casualties.

items.question: How do soldier rarities work in Army Escape?
items.answer: Soldiers in Army Escape range from Common recruits to Mythic commandos. Higher rarity soldiers possess significantly superior damage, health, and squad buff abilities.
